business_problem: Cathedral Studios needed to protect The Bornless from increasingly sophisticated cheating, including AI-driven exploits, so the studio could preserve fair competition, player trust, and long-term community health across multiple regions.
solution_summary: Cathedral Studios implemented Tencent Cloud's Anti-Cheat Expert (ACE) as a managed protection layer for The Bornless instead of relying on a purely reactive in-house process. Gameplay and endpoint signals from live sessions are evaluated by ACE in real time, where Tencent combines a large corpus of cheat samples with AI and big-data analysis to detect traditional hacks alongside newer DMA and AI-assisted attack patterns. The service spans both PC and mobile protection scenarios, giving the studio broad coverage as cheating tactics evolve across platforms. Tencent Cloud also provides deployment guidance and ongoing anti-cheat support so Cathedral can tune defenses without diverting core game-development effort. In effect, the studio added a continuously updated detection-and-enforcement system that helps block malicious behavior quickly, reduces disruption to honest players, and supports healthier multiplayer operations as the game's audience grows.

solution_components.name: Anti-Cheat Expert (ACE)
solution_components.role: Analyzes live gameplay and client signals to detect and block cheating across The Bornless.

data_flow: Live gameplay and client-behavior signals flow from The Bornless into ACE, which applies cheat-sample intelligence plus AI and big-data analysis to identify suspicious behavior and return enforcement decisions that protect active matches and broader game integrity.
business_outcome: Cathedral Studios gained a stronger anti-cheat posture for The Bornless, helping the studio reduce gameplay disruption, defend player trust, and maintain a safer competitive environment as the game scales.
architecture_clues: ACE protects both PC and mobile game scenarios.

evidence_quotes: Cathedral Studios sought robust anti-cheat measures capable of detecting a wide variety of threats, from traditional hacks to emerging AI-driven cheats.
ACE delivers comprehensive coverage across both PC and mobile games, providing real-time detection and protection mechanisms that adapt to evolving cheat methods.

Backed by nearly 20 years of anti-cheat experience and a vast database of cheat samples, ACE employs advanced AI and big data technologies to identify and counter emerging threats like DMA (Direct Memory Access) and AI-based cheats.

By implementing Tencent Cloud's ACE, Cathedral Studios bolsters The Bornless against a wide range of evolving threats, ensuring fair competition and a high-quality experience for its growing player base.
